references.text: Concerns sinning unintentionally against the Lord's commands, the same theme of unintentional sin as in 5:17
Describes when someone among the people sins unintentionally by doing something the Lord has forbidden
Part of the same context regarding guilt offerings and unconscious sins
The preceding verse which also deals with guilt offerings for unintentional sin
Parallel text about unintentional sin and bearing one's guilt
Regulations for the guilt offering mentioned in 5:17
The principle that whoever sins must bear their own wrongdoing
Uses the same expression 'to bear one's wrongdoing' (וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ)
Concerns hidden sins that a person is not aware of
Refers to offerings for sins committed in ignorance under the old covenant
